title: Time travel to 14th-century Mount Athos

tellings.quote: In 1991, I went on a pilgrimage to Mount Athos, Greece, and I'm sitting at this I fell asleep, sort of napping on this stone chair facing the church.
I saw that town again but back in back in the 1500s, you know, and I go there and I present my credentials so to speak at the capital
tellings.difference: Sets the past in the 1400s-1500s rather than the 14th century, and adds that he arrived as the monk Odious Maximus, presented his credentials, and that the monk Gabriel and Evagrius were involved.
tellings.link_reason: The same teller's 1991 dream on the Mount Athos pilgrimage of travelling back in time to old Mount Athos, which is the stored time-travel story.

as_told.title: Dream time travel back to 1500s Mount Athos as the monk Odious Maximus

plain: A former CIA chief named Rolf Mowatt-Larssen says that in 1991 he travelled back in time while on Mount Athos, a group of monasteries in Greece. He tells it himself: on a pilgrimage there, he dozed off on a stone chair facing a church. He says he then saw the same town as it was centuries earlier, around the 1400s or 1500s, rather than the 14th century of the story's title. There, he says, he arrived as a monk, presented his credentials at the capital, and met a monk named Gabriel and someone called Evagrius. He tells both parts on one 2026 episode with Jesse Michels. To him it is proof that the mind can reach into the past.
